**If this issue affects you, please react with a 👍 (thumbs up emoji) to the initial post.**

Your feedback helps us prioritize which bugs to investigate and address first.

![Visits](https://hits.seeyoufarm.com/api/count/incr/badge.svg?url=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fstreamlit%2Fstreamlit%2Fissues%2F7556&title=visits&edge_flat=false)

> With the File Uploader and Chat input , any user input provided for the 1st time disapperars immediately.

# Import required packages
import streamlit as st
import random
import time

st.title("Simple chat")

# Initialize chat history
if "messages" not in st.session_state:
    st.session_state.messages = []

# Display chat messages from history on app rerun
for message in st.session_state.messages:
    with st.chat_message(message["role"]):
        st.markdown(message["content"])
# File uploader
uploaded_files = st.sidebar.file_uploader(
    label="Upload", type=["pdf"], accept_multiple_files=True
)

# Accept user input
if prompt := st.chat_input("What is up?"):
    # Display user message in chat message container
    with st.chat_message("user"):
        st.markdown(prompt)
    # Add user message to chat history
    st.session_state.messages.append({"role": "user", "content": prompt})

![image](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/assets/105560839/777c7ccf-6cb0-4285-a58b-d97ed3532b9f)
 
**Debug info:**

- Streamlit version: 1.27.2
- Python version: 3.11
- Operating System: Linux 
- Browser: Chrome

I hope this helps you.

Here is another example based on @Anianonymous 

```python
import time
import streamlit as st

if "messages" not in st.session_state:
    st.session_state.messages = []

# A count to record the index of dialog
if 'count' not in st.session_state:
    st.session_state.count = 0

for message in st.session_state.messages:
    with st.chat_message(message["role"]):
        st.markdown(message["content"])

uploaded_files = st.sidebar.file_uploader(
    label="Upload", type=["pdf"], accept_multiple_files=True
)

if prompt := st.chat_input("What is up?"):
# Display user message in chat message container
    with st.chat_message("user"):
        st.markdown(prompt)
    # Add user message to chat history
    st.session_state.messages.append({"role": "user", "content": prompt})
    st.session_state.count += 1

    # Sleep one second here to simulate the process of assistant.
    time.sleep(1)
    with st.chat_message('assistant'):
        assistant = f'Good at {st.session_state.count}'
        st.markdown(assistant)
    # Add assistant message to chat history
    st.session_state.messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": assistant})
```
After the **first** user input, the reply of the assistant won't display. But after the **second** user input, it works correctly.
![image](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/assets/26739999/3b0952ab-5ae1-43d1-b186-57f4ae8c63a4)

However, if you remove the `sidebar.file_uploader`, it works correctly.
![image](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/assets/26739999/46a01b3a-868f-4b36-8807-e5ccc9ea8417)

In addition, it also works correctly if `streamlit==1.25.0`
![image](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/assets/26739999/353947e4-bcdb-4a07-9028-51ac2a132b7e)


Debug info:

- Streamlit version: 1.27.2
- Python version: 3.11
- Operating System: Linux
- Browser: Firefox
Using streamlit 1.25, `st.file_uploader` threw an error: AxiosError: Request failed with status code 403.
